notes:
Lead: Ben Morales (VP Product) - mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics). Evaluating Redwood Hosted first for speed, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost control.

Key business ask: reduce per-conversation cost by ~40% vs current OpenAI usage while keeping p95 latency < 450ms for agent flows. Team wants model routing by customer tier & region.

POC request summary: 2-week Dedicated POC. Objectives: (1) validate latency & throughput under sample traffic, (2) prove canary + fallback routing works for real traffic, (3) confirm cost delta and rollback behavior.

Technical POC plan (discussed on 2026-03-04 call):
- Provision 2 reserved GPU nodes (us-east-1) + ability to burst to hosted during peak.
- Canary config: route 5% of prod traffic to Dedicated pool for 48 hours, then scale to 20% if stable. Canary window metrics: p50, p95 latency, error rate, token cost.
- Rollback triggers: error rate >2x baseline OR p95 latency increase >200ms OR quality regression on eval set (drop in helpfulness >6%). Immediate rollback = shift all canary traffic back to Hosted API via routing policy.
- Fallback routing strategy: primary -> dedicated(us-east-1, model: rdw-large-8bit-quant), fallback #1 -> hosted(us-east-1, model: rdw-medium-quant), fallback #2 -> hosted(us-west-2, model: rdw-small-quant) for region failover. Routing rules use latency threshold + capacity signals.
- Quality checks: run automated evals (10k prompts) nightly during POC; maintain baseline embedding similarity & rerank precision.
- Cost monitoring: token-level cost breakdown in Console; target blended token cost <$0.004/token for typical chat messages.
- Operational: SE to enable prefix/KV caching and advise batching profiles (target batch size 6 for chat, 16 for embeddings).
